title: Solitary Contentment
author: Madhumita
text:
If any day I feel lost in crowd
Puzzled n jumbled up
I strive n make sure
to go back into self
n discover in silence
again the vigour
to fight n endure storm...

Chant my real inner mantra ,
The strongest I am n will be
Solitude is my soil n hope
is my water , creativity is my light
To bloom in fine fettle
n spread positivity .

To make me aware
That am simple yet beautiful ,
Who never can relinquish
In any way or situations
But to uphold n embark
the confidence back n
Feel the wholesomeness again .

For I know the truth
am plentiful n rich in me
Yes , I am abundant n happy in self
For the ethereal beauty ,
the delicacy , the innocence
My soul possesses .

I love myself in bits
Little more each day
In different way n pace ,
Grow naturally with experiences
To relish the infinite joy around me .
stanzas: If any day I feel lost in crowd
The strongest I am n will be
Solitude is my soil n hope
is my water , creativity is my light
am plentiful n rich in me
Yes , I am abundant n happy in self
